usage: "node-assets tune <input>... --for size|gpu|load|compat[,...] [-o <dir>] [--fidelity 0.9] [--view 1024] [--network 4g] [--amortize N] [--keep hierarchy,texture-size,geometry] [--time-limit 7m]"
description: "Search the levers (texture format and size, quality for color and data maps separately, KTX2 modes, geometry quantize/meshopt/draco and their bits, simplification, dedup/weld/instancing/flattening) for the best result per goal, never going below the fidelity limit. The most promising settings are tried first, so a run stopped by --time-limit still returns good results (marked search: partial). Writes one recipe per input and goal plus a preview image and the full candidate table; does not write models (use `run`)."
goals[4]: "size: smallest download, counting decoder downloads (shared across --amortize assets)","gpu: lowest estimated GPU memory (textures + vertex data)","load: fastest load = download time on --network + measured decode time","compat: fewest required glTF extensions (no decoders), then smallest"
limits[3]: "--time-limit: total budget for the whole run (default 7m); when it runs out the best results so far are written, and a warning gives the command that finishes the search","--fidelity: worst 64px-region SSIM vs the original over 4 views at --view px (default 0.9 at 1024px, the recommended limit for no visible quality loss)","--network: slow-4g (1.6 Mbps) | 4g (9 Mbps, default) | wifi (30 Mbps)"
examples[2]: "node-assets tune assets/helmet.glb --for size,gpu -o recipes/",node-assets tune assets/*.glb --for load --network slow-4g -o recipes/

usage: "node-assets run <recipe> <input>... -o <file.glb|dir/> [--check] [--force]"
description: Apply a recipe (TOON or JSON) to one or more models. --check renders each result and compares it with its input against the recipe's fidelity limit; inputs that fall below are reported.
examples[2]: node-assets run recipes/helmet.size.recipe.toon assets/helmet.glb -o public/models/helmet.glb,node-assets run recipes/helmet.size.recipe.toon assets/ -o public/models/ --check --force

usage: "node-assets inspect <file|dir>... [--against <original|dir>] [--view 1024] [--network 4g]"
description: "Read-only. Size, GPU memory estimate, triangles, textures and required decoders. With --against, also renders each file and its original and reports fidelity (worst 64px-region SSIM over 4 views) and load time. --against <file> compares every input with that file; --against <dir> compares each input with the file of the same name in that directory."
examples[3]: node-assets inspect assets/,node-assets inspect out/helmet.glb --against assets/helmet.glb,node-assets inspect public/models/ --against assets/
